trust_decision.summary: Repo-controlled display labels (file names, branch/sha refs, and the composed '<path> (<sha7>)' rename labels) are trusted as text only: they must enter the DOM as text nodes, never as parsed HTML; the decision is made at render time inside the two diff banner builders.

landing_point.why: It is the fallback text-diff banner: the one place that interpolates the reference/base/challenger labels straight into innerHTML, and the first thing an engineer reading 'diff header labels' would open.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The three surviving innerHTML writes are error banners, not diff labels, so a solver can argue the advisory only covers labels (the header text) and that server error strings are trusted.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
The diff error banner intentionally turns newlines into '
' and the existing specs assert the banner's innerHTML contains the message, so a blanket 'no innerHTML in the diff views' rewrite silently loses multi-line error formatting.

O6_input_shapes: single plain label string (ref, short sha, or special ref such as 'HEAD'/'WORKING')
two labels for a normal diff: reference + challenger
three labels for a merge conflict: reference + common-ancestor + challenger (NotebookDiff.ts:399-404, PlainTextDiff.ts:75-77)
undefined or empty base label that must be filtered out (the pre-fix filter is on falsiness, the banner class is chosen from labels[1] !== undefined)
composed rename labels '<previousFilePath> (<sha7>)' / '<filePath> (<sha7>)' built when a file was relocated (src/commandsAndMenu.tsx:1338-1345)
translated labels ('Common Ancestor' at NotebookDiff.ts:249, 'Current'/'Incoming'/'Result' at commandsAndMenu.tsx:1349-1368)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A banner in the image diff view that renders referenceLabel/challengerLabel through the same DOM-HTML path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This provider renders exactly the same two labels today and only escapes by accident of React JSX; the diff providers were split into separate plugins in 0.54.0a0, so a maintainer copying header code between them is the repo's own idiom.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: File-list file name rendering that highlights a matched substring with markup instead of text
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The component already splits a path into filename and folder for display; adding search-match highlighting there is a natural change and would reach for HTML.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The raw file path plus reference/challenger labels are concatenated into the diff widget id used for tab de-duplication
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Any later feature that surfaces that id/subtitle in the tab would carry the unescaped label past the render-time check, and sanitising the labels at the producer instead would change the id and break tab reuse.
